00049 LPFUGenInternal::LPFUGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& freq) throw()
00050 : UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00051  y1(0.f), y2(0.f), a0(0.f), b1(0.f), b2(0.f),
00052  currentFreq(0.f)

00054  inputs[Input] = input;
00055  inputs[Freq] = freq;

00064 void LPFUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00065 {
00066  double piOverSampleRate = UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() * pi;
00067  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00068  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00069  float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00070  float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00071  float y0;
00072  float newFreq = *freqSamples;
00073   
00074  if(newFreq != currentFreq)
00075  {
00076   float slope = 1.f / numSamplesToProcess;
00077   float pfreq = max(0.01f, newFreq) * piOverSampleRate;
00078   
00079   float C = 1.f / tan(pfreq);
00080   float C2 = C * C;
00081   float sqrt2C = C * sqrt2;
00082   
00083   float next_a0 =   1.f / (1.f + sqrt2C + C2);
00084   float next_b1 =  -2.f * (1.f - C2) * next_a0 ;
00085   float next_b2 = -(1.f - sqrt2C + C2) * next_a0;
00086    
00087   float a0_slope = (next_a0 - a0) * slope;
00088   float b1_slope = (next_b1 - b1) * slope;
00089   float b2_slope = (next_b2 - b2) * slope;
00090   
00091   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00092   {
00093    y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00094    *outputSamples++ = a0 * (y0 + 2.f * y1 + y2);
00095    y2 = y1; 
00096    y1 = y0;   
00097   
00098    a0 += a0_slope;
00099    b1 += b1_slope;
00100    b2 += b2_slope;
00101   }  
00102  }
00103  else
00104  {
00105   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00106   {
00107    y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00108    *outputSamples++ = a0 * (y0 + 2.f * y1 + y2);
00109    y2 = y1; 
00110    y1 = y0;   
00111   }
00112  }
00113  
00114  y1 = zap(y1);
00115  y2 = zap(y2);
00116  currentFreq = newFreq;
00117 }

00120 LPF::LPF(UGen const& input, UGen const& freq) throw()
00121 {
00122  int numChannels = 1;
00123  numChannels = input.getNumChannels() > numChannels ? input.getNumChannels() : numChannels;
00124  numChannels = freq.getNumChannels()  > numChannels ? freq.getNumChannels() : numChannels;
00125  
00126  initInternal(numChannels);
00127  
00128  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00129  {
00130   internalUGens[i] = new LPFUGenInternal(input, freq);
00131  }
00132 }
